_what: ADDENDUM to the StudyD218-DA pre-registration, received after d218_prereg.json was frozen at PREREG_SHA256 e08117903db9caf64b4fca6b0b195836c65625cf518831cadb3fbe28049ed1ef and BEFORE any cell of this study ran.
_why_it_is_a_separate_file: the first file is frozen by hash. A frozen pre-registration is not edited in place, so the two additions arrive as their own hashed document and both hashes are reported. The precedent is results/orchestration/live2/placeholder_fixes/d211_host_attribution_prereg_addendum.json.

_what_it_does_and_does_not_change.unchanged: the rule, its sign, its units, MARGIN_CF, the enactment, the counters already declared, the pass condition, the proofs and the registration plan. No parameter moves and no bar moves (D187).
_what_it_does_and_does_not_change.added: an INSTRUMENTATION requirement (item 1) and a PREPARED-NOT-POSTED live pair (item 2). Item 1 adds a record per denial; it cannot change a decision because nothing reads it.

ITEM_1_PER_DENIAL_TRADE_RECORD.requirement: for EVERY denial (every decision where the new branch fires and ra.decision becomes DEVICE) the PREDICTED TRADE is recorded AT THE DENIAL, not reconstructed afterwards from an aggregate.

fields_per_denial.own_lost_weighted_p_on_time: w_d x p_self: THE TERM THE RULE SUBTRACTS. Under replacement semantics (D165 B, D177 (1)) it is this question's own expected on-time cloud answer, forfeited by leaving it to the device.
fields_per_denial.saved_on_time_answers_by_type: the predicted on-time cloud answers saved, BROKEN DOWN BY THE TYPE OF THE DEVICES SAVED: alert, recall, assistance, each as its own number.
fields_per_denial.saved_total: the harm term that was actually compared against the bar
fields_per_denial.bar: w_d x MARGIN_CF under the committed decider reading
fields_per_denial.net: saved_total - own_lost_weighted_p_on_time, the quantity compared against the bar
fields_per_denial.context: time, decider device, session, query id, u_rebuild, free KV, w_d, p_self, the number of other requests moved, by type

ITEM_1_PER_DENIAL_TRADE_RECORD.THE_SUMMATION_OBLIGATION_STATED_IN_ADVAN: the by-type breakdown must SUM to the harm term compared against the bar. It does so by construction: cf_protect_defer.harm_on_time accumulates harm_by_type from the SAME rows whose value_lost sums to cf_objective.harm_warm_from_queue_delay's total, so sum(by_type) == harm_unscaled exactly. harm == harm_unscaled x harm_scale, and harm_scale is 1.0 on every scorable path, so sum(by_type) == the compared harm on every scorable path. The report states the residual explicitly rather than claiming it; where harm_scale is not 1.0 the arm is the harm0 NEGATIVE CONTROL, which fires no denial at all, so no denial record can exist under a scale other than 1.0.
ITEM_1_PER_DENIAL_TRADE_RECORD.EXPLICIT_ZEROS_ARE_REQUIRED: all three types appear in every record and in every total, with a value of 0.0 where no device of that type was saved. A type that is never the one saved is a finding about WHERE the mechanism acts and is not omitted. harm_by_type as returned carries only the types that had rows, so the three keys are filled from a fixed list.
ITEM_1_PER_DENIAL_TRADE_RECORD.TOTALS: the per-type and overall totals are reported at 1x AND at 0.25x.
ITEM_1_PER_DENIAL_TRADE_RECORD.register_of_these_numbers: PREDICTED, not observed. Every term is the policy's own prediction at decision time from the committed D162 price and the committed on-time curve. A dry cell has no engine, so no denial's realised outcome is observable and none is claimed.

ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.status: PREPARED, NOT POSTED. The coordinator holds the post pending the user's resolution of the D216 (2) E1 conflict. This session writes the cell lines and the header and posts nothing.
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.authorisation: the user has approved ONE FAIL-FAST LIVE PAIR, FOR THIS PAIR ONLY, conditional on the dry proof passing ALL pre-registered conditions.
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.gating: GATED BEHIND the current FINAL_LADDER_CELLS, which is live on the H100 and must not be disturbed
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.pool_of_record: engine pool 15,760 = 985 x 16 confirmed on hardware; logical 15,736 via the _kv0.25 tag
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.pre_registered_bar: the FROZEN D190 (3) rung-4 test at 0.25x: alert attainment ABOVE rung 3's AND robot on-time retention at least 0.90 of rung 3's gain over base, REPORTED BESIDE robot correct-by-deadline, single-shot within 2 s, and total on-time cloud answers.
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.THE_HELD_CONFLICT_RECORDED_HERE_BECAUSE_: D216 (2) requires E1, the AsyncLive2Backend /metrics scrape, to land BEFORE any 0.25x policy cell, and E1 has not landed. Without it obs.cloud.gpu_kv_fraction is 0.0 in every live2 cell, which is the MINIMUM of [0, 1] and the most permissive value an admission gate can be handed, and it is 0.0 because nothing reads /metrics at all rather than because a fetch failed. Rung 4's protect-and-defer free-KV gate is the only covex-v6 read of that field. On a 0.25x live pair without E1 the one gate meant to see memory pressure would read KV EMPTY throughout the cell that exists to test memory pressure, so a null there would be Rule 2 UNEXERCISED and must not be read as 'rung 4 does not help under pressure'. The committed d216 cells measured pd_kv_bound_by_engine_metric = 0 in every cell, so every rung-4 magnitude so far rests on the belief-side estimate and is unvalidated against a real occupancy reading.
ITEM_2_LIVE_PAIR_PREPARED_AND_NOT_POSTED.why_the_dry_work_is_unaffected: a dry cell has no engine, so gpu_kv_fraction is structurally absent there and the belief-side estimate is the declared source. Nothing in the frozen pre-registration or in the proofs depends on E1.
